'''Dathis Elgin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an Imperial advisor to [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|House Thul faces a crisis that threatens to undermine their entire position on Alderaan and the Empire's as well.|Dathis Elgin informing the Imperial spacer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], he tasked an Imperial spacer to deal with a former Rist [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was threatening to divulge secrets between [[House Rist]] and [[House of Thul|House Thul]].<ref name="TOR" />
